evaluation_mode: fresh environment, checkpoint reload, deterministic actions, learning disabled

metric_standard.speed: vehicle-weighted mean speed over unique controlled lanes
metric_standard.queue: mean halting length over unique controlled lanes, halting_number * 7.5 m
metric_standard.waiting: mean waiting time over unique vehicles on controlled lanes
metric_standard.travel_time: mean completed-vehicle arrival time minus departure time
metric_standard.delay: mean completed-vehicle travel time minus route free-flow travel time
metric_standard.throughput: cumulative arrived vehicles per evaluation episode
metric_standard.completion_rate: completed departed vehicles divided by departed vehicles
metric_standard.incomplete_vehicles: departed vehicles not completed by episode end
metric_standard.teleport_count: unique vehicles observed in SUMO teleport events

method_metadata: independent PPO policies without graph communication, centralized critic, or action prior
training_objective: local-global cooperative environment reward with independent PPO returns and no action prior
